Dear Mr. Haddad,

Please find attached the final invoice for the Lakeside project, number INV-3321, for $18,640. This covers the remaining 40 percent of the fee plus the two change orders you approved on September 30.

Payment is due by November 28. If you prefer to pay by ACH, our banking details are on the second page.

It has been a pleasure working with your team. Ms. Varga asked me to pass on her thanks as well.

Best regards,
Samuel Oduya
